name: Kawajima (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Kawajima town emblem in red: a ring open at the bottom enclosing three diagonal bars.
history: Municipal flag of Kawajima, a town in Saitama Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 5 June 1962.

features.role: Kawajima town emblem — a ring open at the bottom enclosing three diagonal bars
